verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents official client SDKs: a WebSDK (now 2.0) with token-based initialization, event messages and customization, a React package, and Mobile SDKs, including an iOS theme API. Developers can clearly build against first-party SDKs and test them in Sandbox. Missing for 10: no evidence of official server-side or backend language SDKs (the API is described only as plain REST), no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), limited Android coverage, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
